404.author: zy95-12
404.body:
Related: #339 (docs-only; keeps issue open — residual external picker). Related #352.

Folder import can work in a native browser while an external automation host rejects the same directory path. Add matching English and Chinese guidance to the existing Skills import guide so users can choose a complete-package alternative.

The note explains native Chromium `webkitdirectory` support, disabled Folder and ZIP/Git recovery in unsupported browsers (#352), and the remaining Scenario 2 Case A style host/driver limitation. It also identifies J11's successful directory `setInputFiles` coverage and explains that J11 is not blocked by that external picker gap. Only two Markdown files change.

Refs #339. Related: #352. This documentation follow-up leaves the external host limitation open.

## Validation

Candidate: `e54506e7`.

- `pnpm docs:check`: PASS, 141 Markdown files linted and checked for local links, 0 issues.
- `git diff --check`: PASS. Reviewed both translations against all five requested points and the existing J11 source.
- `pnpm ci:st`: PASS, 16 planned / 16 executed / 16 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped.
- `pnpm ci:ut`: blocked at `NON_ROOT_REQUIRED` preflight, 4,311 planned / 0 executed / 0 passed / 0 assertion failures / 0 skipped; the runner verdict is FAIL because nothing ran. The same layer on unmodified upstream main (`8811fcad`) reproduced the same preflight and counts in a separate worktree.
- `pnpm ci:e2e`: incomplete, 91 planned. The first research journey, AR-01 in `artifact-revision-mocked.spec.ts`, timed out at 180 seconds (0 passed, 1 observed failure). Stopped the remaining local run under memory pressure on this 3.4 GiB worker; no final aggregate counts were produced. A baseline E2E preparation attempt was also stopped before execution, so this timeout is not attributed as a proven upstream regression or a product regression.
- No product, UI, import pipeline, tests, or CI changes. No paid model tests were run.

## E2E user journeys

Not applicable to the change: these are documentation-only edits with no changed product path. The attempted full local browser layer is reported separately above and did not reach J11; no new J11 pass is claimed. The documented J11 behavior is supported by its existing source and the passing current-head CI evidence recorded in #352.

## Release

Release category: release:docs

User impact: clearer Folder compatibility and complete-package ZIP/Git alternatives.

Compatibility and migration: none.
404.head: docs/339-folder-import-limitation
404.title: docs(skills): clarify folder import browser and automation limits (#339)
